items.name: Diamondback Energy
items.headline: Agrees to buy Double Eagle subsidiaries for shares plus cash
items.catalyst: Form 8-K (Nov. 16): definitive agreement for about 15.56 million shares and $2.15 billion of cash, subject to customary adjustments.
items.thesis: The assets cover approximately 176,000 net acres in the Midland Basin and are valued at approximately 4.0x estimated 2027 EBITDA, per the company. Closing is expected Dec. 21, 2026.

items.name: Aon
items.headline: Completes USI acquisition for $17.0B total purchase price
items.catalyst: Form 8-K (Nov. 16): Aon completed the acquisition of USI for a total purchase price of $17.0 billion.
items.thesis: Aon cites $395 million of expected net adjusted EBITDA synergies and says it will update its 2027 outlook, including USI, when it reports fourth-quarter earnings in early 2027.

items.name: Keurig Dr Pepper
items.headline: Launches $2.0B common stock offering to pay down debt
items.catalyst: Form 8-K (filed Nov. 16): Nov. 12 release announcing an underwritten public offering of $2.0 billion of common stock.
items.thesis: Net proceeds are intended to repay or repurchase approximately $2.0 billion of debt ahead of the planned separation into Beverage Co. and Global Coffee Co., targeted for early 2027. The underwriters have a 30-day option for up to $300 million more.

items.name: Moderna
items.headline: Amends Ares term loan: lower margins, maturity extended to 2031
items.catalyst: Form 8-K, Item 1.01 (Nov. 16): Amendment No. 1 to the November 2025 credit agreement, effective Nov. 9.
items.thesis: Margins fall from 5.50% to 4.75% on SOFR-based loans and from 4.50% to 3.75% on base-rate loans, and maturity moves from Nov. 24, 2030 to Nov. 24, 2031.

items.name: American Tower
items.headline: Prices €1.2B of euro senior notes due 2031 and 2034
items.catalyst: Form 8-K, Item 8.01 (Nov. 16): priced €600.0 million of notes due 2031 at 4.200% and €600.0 million due 2034 at 4.500%.
items.thesis: Expected net proceeds are €1,191.3 million (about $1,317.0 million), to be used for general corporate purposes including refinancing upcoming euro maturities.

items.name: Invitation Homes
items.headline: Investor presentation lifts 2026 disposition guidance midpoint to $950M
items.thesis: The presentation shows a fiscal 2026 disposition guidance midpoint of $950 million, year-to-date dispositions of $918 million, and October blended rental rate growth of +2.2%.

items.name: Cheniere Energy
items.headline: Names Zach Davis President and CFO
items.catalyst: Form 8-K, Item 5.02 (Nov. 16): Davis promoted from Executive Vice President and CFO to President and CFO, effective Nov. 12, 2026.
items.thesis: He has served as CFO since August 2020 and continues to report to Chairman and CEO Jack Fusco.
